price.basis: the default `advanced` mode with 10 results per request, which is what the evaluation sends; `basic` is also $5, `fast` and `turbo` $1 per 1,000, extra results $1 per 1,000; 5,000 requests a month are free

reachability.note: The vendor's pages state no regional availability.

parallel-search-reference.source: Parallel documentation: Search quickstart (docs.parallel.ai/search/search-quickstart) and Search API reference (docs.parallel.ai/api-reference/search/search)
parallel-search-reference.note: POST https://api.parallel.ai/v1/search (generally available; no beta header on /v1) with the `x-api-key` header; `search_queries` (required), `objective`, `mode` (turbo, fast, basic, advanced; default advanced), `max_chars_total`, `advanced_settings` (max_results default 10, excerpt settings, source policy, fetch policy, location); unknown fields are rejected. The response is `{search_id, results[], warnings, usage, session_id}`, each result `url`, `title` (nullable), `publish_date`, `excerpts[]`.

parallel-pricing.source: Parallel pricing page (parallel.ai/pricing) and rate limits page (docs.parallel.ai/resources/rate-limits)
parallel-pricing.note: Search per 1,000 requests with 10 results: Turbo $1 (~200 ms), Fast $1 (~700 ms), Basic $5 (~1 s), Advanced $5 (~3 s); extra results $1 per 1,000; up to 5,000 requests a month free; 600 requests per minute. No regional statement.

parallel-search-mcp.note: https://search.parallel.ai/mcp, tools `web_search` and `web_fetch`, "no API key required" and free to use anonymously at lower rate limits in `fast` mode; with a key, `Authorization: Bearer`. This is the keyless service ADR 0080 §7 names and the existing search forwarder speaks.

openQuestions: The anonymous MCP's rate limit is not published; the evaluation measures the keyed /v1/search interface, not the MCP.
